BL-1821 — Once a week the recruiter scouts a batch of up to N unseen Hugging Face candidates for the local specifier seat, batteries each with the specifier battery, re-batteries the model the steward currently favours for specifier, and keeps a score table (.swarmforge/recruiter/score-table.json) whose recommend line names a challenger only when it passes more than the incumbent - an offer, never a staffing change
What it solves: ## Human, verbatim (Article 5.3)
Approval context: A new feature file needs your tap; no choice is posed. FIRM: the batch size N is operator-tunable (default 3); the scout runs once a week from the existing weeknight recruiter hook, not nightly (each pull is gigabytes); the incumbent is the steward's top certified local recommendation for specifier…
BL-1821 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1821" (or "reject BL-1821 <reason>") to act.
